name: compartment_out_of_class

gates._note: Pre-registered before running. Report-only: these results must not be used to tune anything; a fix motivated by them needs fresh seeds.

_purpose: Out of the model class: a return spring (60 N/m at the handle) pulls the part closed. Single-joint quasi-static models without springs cannot explain it, and a released part shuts. Correct behaviour: no false success; ideally model_inadequate. Measures the Panda adequacy check's detection power, unmeasured so far.
